about: The honor snack bar iPad. priceCents is the price of every snack in cents (150 is $1.50): Grant, Oct 31, 2026. The other numbers are PLACEHOLDERS until club staff confirm them (see CLAUDE.md). itemsPerEntryMax: the most snacks one press of the button can record (a typo guard). itemsPerDayMax: the most snacks one member can have recorded on the iPad in a day. thankYouSeconds: how long the thank-you shows before the iPad goes back to its start for the next person. idleSeconds: how long the iPad waits, untouched, on any other screen before it goes back to the start.
